eps.ov: Uesugi Fuutarou lands a tutoring job that promises five times the normal pay. As it turns out, it’s going to take more than five times the work.
eps.oa: يحصل «فوتارو أويسوغي» على عمل مدرّس خصوصي يَعِد بخمسة أضعاف الأجر المعتاد. ويتبين أن العمل سيتطلب أكثر من خمسة أضعاف الجهد.

eps.ov: Futaro proposes an exam to settle the debate of whether or not the quintuplets need a tutor.
eps.oa: يقترح «فوتارو» امتحاناً يحسم الجدل في حاجة التوائم الخمس إلى مدرّس أو عدمها.

eps.ov: Nino isn't happy that Futaro is beginning to get along with her sisters, so she takes matters into her own hands.
eps.oa: لا يسر «نينو» أن «فوتارو» بدأ يتفاهم مع أخواتها، فتأخذ الأمر بيدها.

eps.ov: Futaro receives his first pay, and decides to take Raiha to the arcade, where she’s always wanted to go.
eps.oa: يتسلم «فوتارو» أول أجر له، فيقرر أن يأخذ «رايها» إلى صالة الألعاب التي طالما تمنت أن تذهب إليها.

eps.ov: The fireworks have started, but the girls are still split up. Ichika wanders off on her own, and Futaro goes after her.
eps.oa: بدأت الألعاب النارية، لكن الفتيات ما زلن متفرقات. وتهيم «إيتشيكا» وحدها، فيلحق بها «فوتارو».

eps.ov: The midterm exams are coming up, and the girls' father set Futaro up to a seemingly impossible task.
eps.oa: اقتربت امتحانات منتصف الفصل، ويضع أبو الفتيات «فوتارو» أمام مهمة تبدو مستحيلة.

eps.ov: Futaro spent the night at the quintuplets' apartment. He wakes up to an unexpected situation.

eps.t: The Photo That Started It All
eps.ov: Futaro falls ill after Miku feeds him a hefty serving of croquettes. Nino makes the situation even worse than it needs to be.
School is abuzz about the camp school trip coming up. Meanwhile, Raiha catches the flu.
Futaro and the girls arrive at camp school. His outfit for the test of courage causes more than just a scare for Nino.
Ichika and Futaro get locked in the storage shed. The others are concerned about their absence, but not necessarily for the same reasons.
It’s the last day of camp school. Itsuki is missing. Futaro thinks he knows where to find her, but he’s sick and shouldn’t be wandering in the snow.
